# Synthetic citation demonstration

This document tests software. Its references and claims are **fictional**;
never use these item identities as real evidence.

An example citation [cite](sr-cite:users/123/items/ABCD2345) stays readable in
ordinary Markdown after rendering, while its Zotero identity is retained.
A second source [cite](sr-cite:groups/456/items/EFGH6789) is in a different library.

## Flexible artifacts

- Extraction could be a spreadsheet, a CSV, or prose notes.
- Analysis could be a script or a reasoned narrative.
- Neither a database nor subagents are compulsory.

| Artifact | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Evidence notes | Source-linked observations |
| Analysis script | Reproducible calculations |

A repeated citation [cite](sr-cite:users/123/items/ABCD2345) remains live in the export.
